lines.text: Say the month, then the day!
Many learners say: I was born on 5 of May.
Better: I was born on May 5.
Say the month, then the day.
The second! My birthday is May 5.

data.wrong: I was born on 5 of May.
data.why: Say the month, then the day.

native.tip: نقول «الخامس من مايو»، أما في الإنجليزية الأمريكية فنقول الشهر ثم اليوم: “I was born on May 5.” وليس “I was born on 5 of May.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «الخامس من مايو», but in American English we say the month first, then the day: “I was born on May 5.” not “I was born on 5 of May.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I was born on 5 of May.” 😅 In Arabic we say «الخامس من مايو», but in American English we say the month first, then the day, so the right sentence is “I was born on May 5.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
